title: Flashback
description:
New Game!
Please scroll down to MORE FROM RENKA!

Об игреYou will play as a deliveryman and encounter various characters and events. You need to make your own judgments and choices.
After that, your attributes will change according to the outcomes of your choices.

When your attributes drop to zero or go too high, you will meet a bad ending or something special.
The attributes will change slowly over time to prepare you for the incoming accidents.

For example, you can give up the current event and let another personality take your place to handle all the problems for you.
In this situation, the current event and changes to your attributes will be interrupted.

Quitting an event comes with a price. Your attributes will decline after giving up events but your level will rise instead.
Your level may play an essential role on certain occasions and determine the course of events.

On Day 30, something will happen and you may reach the end or go back to the first day.
Anyway, the fate of the characters depends on your choices.
description_short: Flashback is a strategy game oriented to your choices. You will play the role of a deliveryman and live in a turbulent city for a month. You will meet various characters and experience events, and those characters' fates will cross and they will usher in their own futures based on your choices.
